description: This Java source file implements a custom Text-to-Speech (TTS) engine for Android, named 'RobotSpeakTtsService'. It generates speech by synthesizing audio signals based on character frequency mappings, with support for different language variants. The class extends Android's TextToSpeechService and manages language loading, synthesis, and stopping operations, including handling of audio buffers and character normalization.

classes.name: RobotSpeakTtsService
classes.description: Custom Android TTS service class that synthesizes speech based on character frequency mappings, supporting multiple languages and variants, to generate robotic speech sounds.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, loads shared preferences, and loads the default language.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onIsLanguageAvailable
methods.description: Determines if a language/country/variant combination is supported.

methods.name: onLoadLanguage
methods.description: Loads specified language files, initializes frequency map and sets current language, returns status.

methods.name: onSynthesizeText
methods.description: Synthesizes speech for given text request, character by character, generating audio signals.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes input character to range 'a'-'z' for consistent mapping.

methods.name: buildFrequencyMap
methods.description: Builds a map of characters to their frequency values from data loaded from assets.

methods.name: generateOneSecondOfAudio
methods.description: Generates a second of audio for a given character based on its frequency, or silence.

methods.name: getAmplitude
methods.description: Retrieves amplitude for waveforms, optionally whisper mode.
